candidates.summary: save_game_zp: drop the saves of viewport_left_low (&B2, slot 21), viewport_right_low (&B3, 22), viewport_left_high (&BA, 29) and viewport_right_high (&BB, 30); restore_game_zp stopped reading them (G0257) so the four copies are dead stores. 28 cycles, 20 bytes a pass. Alternatives: the two halves below overlap this.
candidates.equivalence: Each removed LDA zp / STA zp_save+k pair only copies a zero-page byte into zp_save+k; the LDA changes A, which is overwritten by the next pair's LDA (and the last LDA before RTS belongs to a later pair), flags are dead (RTS, caller's JSR save_game_zp is followed by LDA shown_screen). No instruction ever reads zp_save+k for the removed k, so deleting the pair changes only an unread byte of the renderer's workspace.
candidates.relies_on: zp_save + 21/22/29/30 are never read: grep zp_save over src/ and tools/ finds only render_zp.6502 (restore_game_zp has no load of +22, +29, +30; its LDA zp_save + 21 is a dead load whose A is overwritten by the next LDA, and is in accepted G0257's text). The slots keep their numbers (zp_save + n unchanged for the others, the holes stay unused like +12/+13), so no data moves. render's .scrolled/buffer_to_view with X=2 puts &B2/&B3/&BA/&BB back from buf_vl_lo/vr_lo/vl_hi/vr_hi slot 2 (view_to_buffer saved them at the start), as G0257 relied on. Page crossings: save_game_zp is straight-line code with no branches and no indexed reads; it sits before restore_game_zp (abs loads, straight line) and render_bss_zero (run once at start-up), so sliding the following bytes down 10 or 20 moves no hot branch or table read. Reads of the saved bytes elsewhere: none.
